topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes and outlines the main learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Viral origins of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how studying tumor viruses and retroviral transduction led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and genetics of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: They define the functional categories of cancer genes and illustrate how allele dosage and specific mutations disrupt cell cycle control.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genomic instability
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the cellular defects and DNA repair failures that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer development and influences clinical phenotypes.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, offers recommended reading, and previews the next lecture.
